scripts.check: node scripts/check-stale.mjs && git ls-files -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.mjs' '*.css' '*.sh' 'index.html' | grep -v 'schema\.gen\.ts' | xargs node scripts/uncomment.mjs -l && tsc --noEmit
scripts.uncomment: git ls-files -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.mjs' '*.css' '*.sh' 'index.html' | grep -v 'schema\.gen\.ts' | xargs node scripts/uncomment.mjs -w
